lane_rule: Holiday is its own separate lane. Holiday and Personal are separate lanes.
matching_rule: Each holiday assembles candidates by holiday-specific tags, metadata, title support, or admin marks.
ownership_rule: Theme match only. No holiday ownership. Prior campaign use does not create a holiday tie.

minimums.christmas_note: Christmas may exceed 8 and should not be artificially limited.
minimums.deficiency_rule: If a non-Christmas holiday has fewer than 8 KKs, report it for inventory adjustment.

holidays.intent: Warmth, giving, home, wonder, family, faith-friendly seasonal feeling.
holidays.target: Expanded inventory; do not cap at 8.
holidays.source_rule: Christmas title support, Christmas/Holiday tag, metadata, or admin mark.

holidays.intent: Gratitude, love, respect, support, repair where audio truly supports it.
holidays.source_rule: Mother’s Day title support, mother/mom tag, metadata, or admin mark.

holidays.intent: Respect, strength, steadiness, legacy, pride, hope, complicated repair only when exact audio supports it.
holidays.source_rule: Father’s Day title support, father/dad tag, metadata, or admin mark.

holidays.intent: Love, devotion, romance, affection, forever, chosen person.
holidays.source_rule: Valentine title support, love/romance tag, metadata, or admin mark.

holidays.intent: Thanks, gratitude, gathering, family, home, appreciation.
holidays.source_rule: Thanksgiving title support, gratitude/gathering tag, metadata, or admin mark.

holidays.intent: Hope, fresh start, keep going, celebration, future-facing encouragement.
holidays.source_rule: New Year title support, hope/fresh-start tag, metadata, or admin mark.

holidays.intent: Renewal, hope, light, family, faith-friendly spring feeling.
holidays.source_rule: Easter title support, renewal/hope tag, metadata, or admin mark.

holidays.intent: Missing you, honor, memory, grief comfort, legacy, soft support.
holidays.source_rule: Memorial/remembrance title support, grief/memory/honor tag, metadata, or admin mark.
